verdict.rationale: Phaser documents an official MCP server, the Phaser Game Agent MCP at phaser.io/agent/mcp, that lets coding agents build games from plain-language prompts. Separately, the Phaser Editor MCP Server offers 40+ specialised tools and integrates with Claude Desktop, Cursor and GitHub Copilot. A runtime probe confirms the hosted MCP endpoint ('Connect your coding agent') but notes there is no npm MCP package and that non-browser clients get a 403 at the site root. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and detailed setup/auth docs and a tool reference in the evidence.
